name: Newmark-β method
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 以位移和速度的时间离散近似推进动力方程的方法。
usage_note: 该研究采用二维模型、无损轨道及分层各向同性线弹性基础，须保留这些适用条件。
usage_overview: 用于逐步积分车辆与轨道、桥梁或基础组成的耦合运动方程，求取时域动力响应，也用于非线性方程求解及与简谐频域结果对照。涉及基础的应用中，有研究采用二维、无损轨道及分层各向同性线弹性基础模型。

complete_examples.text: In the three-dimensional dynamics model for characterizing the train-track-bridge interaction, Dinh et al. [21] formulated a three-dimensional train-bridge interaction model, where an iterative solution scheme based on Newmark-β method is developed for satisfying the compatibilities at the wheel-rail interfaces.
For such a complex system, direct time integration algorithm such as Newmark-β method can be used to obtain the system responses.
The standard Newmark-β method is used to solve the dynamic equation.
Various numerical integration methods are applicable for dynamically calculating this system, so the Newmark-β method is applied to solve this dynamic system.
A time step of 0.0005 seconds and a Newmark-β method is used to solve Eq. (2.33).
The train-track-bridge coupled equation shown in Eq. (2.33) is formulated using the Direct coupling approach and solved using the Newmark-β method [48].
In the direct time-domain method, the Newmark-β method is used to achieve the time marching process.
